author: Blyth, 1842
status: 나그네새 수천 마리 · 여름철새 수백 마리 · 겨울철새 수백 마리
habitat: 자작나무 숲, 버드나무 숲, 낙엽침엽수 혼합림, 풀이 무성한 툰드라
summary: 우리나라에서는 주로 이동 시기에 볼 수 있는 나그네새이며, 북부 지역에서는 적은 수가 번식하기도 한다. 자작나무 숲과 버드나무 숲, 낙엽침엽수 혼합림, 풀이 우거진 툰드라를 좋아하고, 5월 말에 수컷의 지저귐이 가장 활발하며 2m쯤 되는 분비나무나 신갈나무 꼭대기에서 노래하는 모습이 자주 보인다. 둥지는 주로 볏과 식물 줄기 밑동이나 눈잣나무, 매발톱나무 줄기에 마른 풀줄기를 성글게 엮어 옆에 작은 입구를 낸 긴 공 모양으로 짓고, 흰 알을 낳는다. 겨울은 아시아에서 난다.

art.subject: Dusky Warbler (Phylloscopus fuscatus), adult in spring (sexes alike), singing: upperparts plain dark earthy brown with no green or yellow tones and no wing-bars; a sharp whitish supercilium, brightest and most clear-cut in front of the eye and becoming buffier behind it; a dark brown eye-stripe from the bill to the nape; ear-coverts brown; throat whitish; breast and belly dirty off-white, with a buff-brown wash on the breast sides, flanks and undertail coverts; fine thin bill, dark with a yellowish base to the lower mandible; dark eye; slender brownish legs.
art.pose: perched at the top of a small fir, singing
art.scene: Korean birch and willow woodland with low firs in late spring; no people, buildings or text
art.build: Small, compact leaf warbler, smaller than a sparrow, with a rounded head and short neck. Bill fine and thin, much shorter than the head. Legs slender, mid-brown. Wings short and rounded; at rest the primary tips project only a little beyond the tertials. Tail medium-length, square or slightly rounded, often flicked. Usually keeps low in thick scrub, calling a hard 'tack'; in spring the male sings from the top of a small tree.
avoid: Do not add wing-bars, green upperparts or yellow underparts; the Dusky Warbler is plain brown above and off-white below.
Do not paint a thick bill, stout legs and a supercilium that is diffuse in front of the eye — that is Radde's Warbler (Phylloscopus schwarzi).
Do not add a pale crown stripe.
